description: This file is a shell script for testing the `git rev-list --bisect` functionality. It sets up various test cases, references external test libraries, and defines functions to perform bisect tests on git revision lists with different options and scenarios.

methods.name: test_bisection_diff
methods.description: Performs a diff-based test to verify that the bisecting of git revision list produces a result within specified maximum difference.

methods.name: test_sequence
methods.description: Automates a sequence of bisect tests with various options to validate the bisect functionality in different scenarios.
